title: Binary Search
reason: Master the fundamental divide-and-conquer search pattern on sorted arrays.

title: Search Insert Position
reason: Learn how binary search finds the optimal target insertion index.

title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
reason: Classic interview problem for partitioned binary search conditions.

title: First Bad Version
reason: Demonstrates boundary testing with minimal API calls using binary search.

title: Two Sum
reason: The quintessential hash table problem for O(N) complement lookups.

title: 3Sum
reason: Extends two-pointer technique to triplet sum calculations without duplicates.

title: Maximum Subarray
reason: Fundamental study of Kadane's Algorithm for contiguous sub-segments.

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
reason: Core problem for understanding sliding window with dynamic pointer movement.

title: Climbing Stairs
reason: The best introduction to 1D dynamic programming and recurrence relations.

title: Coin Change
reason: Essential unbounded knapsack DP pattern with state minimization.

title: Merge Intervals
reason: Teaches interval sorting and merging overlapping ranges.

title: Valid Parentheses
reason: Standard LIFO stack validation for balanced bracket sequences.

title: Min Stack
reason: Learn how auxiliary data structures support O(1) minimum retrieval.

title: Reverse Linked List
reason: Crucial pointer manipulation exercise for singly linked lists.

title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
reason: Foundational linked list merging pattern using dummy head pointers.

title: Linked List Cycle
reason: Floyd's Tortoise and Hare algorithm for fast/slow pointer detection.

title: Invert Binary Tree
reason: Classic recursive tree traversal and left-right child swapping.

title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
reason: Introduction to recursive height computation of hierarchical structures.

title: Validate Binary Search Tree
reason: Understand BST invariance rules and bounding range propagation.

title: Number of Islands
reason: The quintessential 2D grid connected-components graph traversal problem.

title: Course Schedule
reason: Teaches cycle detection and topological sorting in directed acyclic graphs.

title: Word Search
reason: Classic backtracking problem for exploring grid paths with state rollback.

title: Combination Sum
reason: Master decision-tree exploration with reuse of candidates.

title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
reason: Master min-heap prioritization and Quickselect linear-time partitioning.

title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
reason: Learn how prefix trees enable fast string prefix matching and search engines.
